title: Israeli Settlers Stop Soldiers From Returning Palestinians to Their Home
summary_full: The Supreme Court had ordered the military to ensure a West Bank family that fled violence could go back. But settlers blocked the effort, with the authorities accused of not doing enough to stop them.
